name: Balthule Shadowstrike
summary: Near the Tower of Althalaxx, Balthule Shadowstrike watches the northern Darkshore coast. He serves Delgren the Purifier as a forward scout, keeping watch on the dark practitioners in the ancient elven ruins.

sections.title: A Scout in the Shadows
sections.body: West of the Tower of Althalaxx, Balthule Shadowstrike keeps a lonely, dangerous watch. Restless spirits and shadowed ruins mark northern Darkshore, but the tower poses a particular threat. Under Delgren the Purifier’s direction, Balthule watches the dark casters who have entered the ancient Highborne ruins.

sections.title: Uncovering the Cult
sections.body: The sorcerers and cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx practice forbidden magic, harvesting artifacts and souls from nearby ruins. Balthule turns to traveling Alliance champions to strike at the cultist leaders and recover parchment and talismans that reveal the reach of their summoning efforts.

faq.answer: Balthule Shadowstrike scouts northern Darkshore. He works with Delgren the Purifier, watching the cultists there.
Balthule Shadowstrike is just west of the Tower of Althalaxx in northern Darkshore, near the coastline.

faq.q: What is his mission at the Tower of Althalaxx?
faq.answer: Balthule was sent to spy on the dark spellcasters and cultists at the Tower of Althalaxx. He gathers intelligence and coordinates strikes against their rituals.
Delgren the Purifier is a human paladin at Maestra's Post in Ashenvale. He coordinates the campaign against the dark forces in northern Darkshore, with Balthule as his forward eyes and ears.

faq.q: What kind of enemies occupy the Tower of Althalaxx?
faq.answer: Dark cultists and sorcerers occupy the Tower of Althalaxx and its grounds, along with summoned demonic or shadowy minions. They seek to use ancient Highborne power for sinister ends.

faq.q: Why is the Alliance interested in these ruins?
faq.answer: The Tower of Althalaxx is an ancient elven structure. Foul sorcery and demonic activity so near elven lands threaten Darkshore and the night elves of Darnassus.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may see the cultists’ desecration of ancient Kalimdor ruins as an outrage. Balthule seeks to avenge it before corruption spreads farther into your lands.
As an Alliance member sent north from Auberdine, you can find Balthule as a forward contact against the dark cultists around the Tower of Althalaxx.
As a rogue, you know the patience and vigilance it takes to work deep in hostile territory under dangerous spellcasters’ noses. Balthule shows those qualities as an elven scout.
